title: Vanishing reciprocal square root of the logarithm
statement: For each natural number $n$, let $a_n = 1/\sqrt{\log(n : \mathbb{R})}$, where the reciprocal is taken in $\mathbb{R}$. Then $a_n$ tends to $0$ as $n$ tends to infinity.
